Both C_01 arguments are framed positively (pro-policy) and are not persuasive enough to sway my strong opposition. The low persuasiveness scores (15/100 and 25/100) indicate they did not resonate with me.

Since none of the new arguments were compelling enough to shift my existing, firm convictions, I will make no changes.
